Instead of using paper licenses that are easily damaged when you encounter rain, you use PET without anxiety.
Vậy đổi bằng lái xe ở đâu và nó có lợi í.zh: 驾照在哪里,有什么用? 事实是PET塑料卡对我们有很多好处. 由PET塑料材料制成,所以你的学位将具有高度的可持续性,特别是抗机械阻力,抗环境及天气的影响非常好. 而不是使用在遇到雨水时容易损坏的纸质许可证,而是使用无忧无虑的PET.

Độ bảo mật thông tin của thẻ nhựa PET ca.en: The information security of high PET plastic cards is not as easy to fake or erase as usual. The card is also incorporated in many of the same types of cards. For example, if you take a motorized driver's license, then you get a driver's license, it's still integrated on a card without having to carry a lot of cards. Your information will be synthesized and available on the national database. Unfortunately, if you lose your card, the leveling process will be quick, easier to ask for the level and not the re-investigation.
Độ bảo mật thông tin của thẻ nhựa PET ca.zh: 高PET塑料卡的信息安全并不像往常那样容易被伪造或抹去. 该卡也融入了许多同类型的卡. 例如,若取出机动车驾驶证,再取出驾驶证,仍被整合入卡上而无需携带多张卡. 您的信息将被综合到国家数据库中。 不幸的是,如果你丢失了卡片,平分过程会很快,更容易要求关卡而不是重新调查.
